newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to issue $525 million in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to issue $525 million in bonds.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana said on Wednesday it was issuing $525 million in convertible bonds at a two-percent coupon.
The bonds will mature in July 2002.

In late June, Telefonica officially informed the Spanish Stock Commission CNMV of plans to issue up to 100 billion pesetas ($645 million) in five-year bonds, denominated in U.S. dollars and convertible into shares.
The issue is designed to finance ordinary company activity.
The issue can be expanded by another 75 million pesetas, Telefonica said.
